title: DOOM on HuskyLens v1.1.0
body:
## What's new

- Added support for `DOOM2.WAD`.
- Added support for Final DOOM: `TNT.WAD` and `PLUTONIA.WAD`.
- Added scrolling to the WAD picker while keeping three visible rows.
- Updated installation documentation with classic Steam WAD locations.
- Documented that WAD files from the newer DOOM + DOOM II re-release may fail with `Bad V_DrawPatch`; use classic IWAD files instead.

## Supported IWADs

- `DOOM.WAD`
- `DOOM2.WAD`
- `TNT.WAD`
- `PLUTONIA.WAD`
- `FREEDOOM1.WAD`
- `FREEDOOM2.WAD`

The firmware remains intentionally soundless. Commercial WAD files are not included.
